verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list glTF loading as a built-in feature, and its asset system can hot-reload scenes, textures and meshes, so one of the three named interchange formats is covered first-party. The evidence never mentions FBX or USD, and nothing shows how clean or complete glTF import actually is. Missing for 10: FBX import, USD import, detailed glTF importer documentation (supported extensions, materials and animation fidelity), and hands-on corroboration that imports come through cleanly.
